task.title: Record the L4b criterion 3 diagnosis, the measured and restored change at d2f9721f, and the prepared owner decision on L4b and L1
task.objective: At d2f9721f the 18 non-actionable answers of the ddcfc35b request are diagnosed as model omissions (12 echo the task sentence, 4 copy the rule code, 2 lose the action to the 160-character limit; for 5 of 14 labelled codes summary plus action run to 171-242 characters), one bounded change (a task sentence asking how to correct each validation issue) was measured on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B over two complete runs at 8/17 and 8/17 actionable by proxy against 9/17 and 7/17, with invented values in 2 answers, and restored byte for byte, so L1.8 is unchanged (GO on all 8, 83,345 ms at cap). An owner decision record on criterion 3 is prepared in the L4 plan and adopted by no one. Append a note to awkit-djnl.6 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the commit, the result and what stays open (the owner's criterion 3 decision, the owner's confirmation of the 11 proposed verdicts, 16 answers awaiting a person, the go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming d2f9721f and its live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 320 issues, 26 outstanding / 294 closed, 180 edges, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: L4b criterion 3 diagnosis and restored change noted on awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
